signatures.description: Design a distributed KV store where clients hold time-based leases, but node clocks drift up to 500ms and the network can reorder messages arbitrarily. Implement lease renewal so linearizability holds even when a slow node believes its lease is still valid after a new leader was elected. Prove safety with a happens-before argument and handle the case where lease expiry is only detectable via a majority quorum read.
